# What leaving the planner's lap cost, measured in the races

213 first stops in 44 races, each with a green window from the decision lap to the team's next stop (or the flag), and at least 3 such cars in its race. Median distance from the planner's lap: 3 laps; median cost the planner predicts for it: 0.61 s.

Excess time over the window (elapsed minus laps times the car's own median green lap), regressed within races on each measure, with the window's length as a control. Intervals resample whole races.

| regressor | slope | 95% interval | reads as |
|---|---|---|---|
| planner's predicted cost (s) | +0.40 | [-0.15, +2.65] | seconds of real excess per predicted second; 1 means the model's costs appear in the clock |
| laps from the planner's lap | +0.42 | [-0.24, +1.11] | real seconds per lap of deviation; the planner itself prices a lap at 0.25 s |

For scale: the median standard deviation of excess time between cars of the same race is 5.6 s.
